digest.en: Myanmar's government moved Aung San Suu Kyi to house arrest. The move comes as the country tries to rehabilitate its image. Israel struck southern Lebanon, killing civilians, despite a ceasefire.
digest.hi: यूएई ने बदलती ऊर्जा कूटनीति के दौर में एक बड़ा दांव खेला है। राष्ट्रपति ट्रंप ने कम आय वालों को सरकार से 1,000 डॉलर तक का मैचिंग देने का नया कार्यकारी आदेश जारी किया है। प्रधानमंत्री ने भारत की कूटनीति में व्यापार, प्रौद्योगिकी और पर्यटन पर फोकस करते हुए 3टी का नारा दिया है।

articles.title: Myanmar attempts to rehabilitate image with Suu Kyi move
articles.summary: Myanmar's state television announced that Aung San Suu Kyi has been transferred from prison to house arrest, over five years after the military coup that removed her from power. This move is seen as an attempt to rehabilitate the country's image.

articles.title: Deadly Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon despite ceasefire
articles.summary: Israeli strikes on southern Lebanon killed 17 people, including two children, according to Lebanon's health ministry. The strikes occurred despite a ceasefire agreement in place. Seventeen people - including two children - were killed, according to Lebanon's health ministry.

articles.title: Kim Jong-un praises North Korean troops who self-detonated to avoid capture in Ukraine war
articles.summary: North Korean leader Kim Jong-un praised troops who self-detonated to avoid capture while fighting in Ukraine. The incident was reported by state media, highlighting the involvement of North Korean troops in the conflict.

articles.title: Iran activates air defences as White House says ceasefire paused Congress deadline
articles.summary: Iran activated air defences for around 20 minutes, according to Tasnim and Fars news agencies. The situation returned to normal shortly after, amid a reported pause in ceasefire talks and a looming US Congressional deadline.

articles.title: Ukraine begins to flex muscle as an emerging air power, angering Russia
articles.summary: Ukraine has begun conducting air attacks, prompting Russian officials to urge vigilance and label the actions as terrorism. The developments have strained tensions between the two nations, with Russia responding to Ukraine's emerging air power.

articles.title: UK police charge man over stabbing of two Jewish men in London
articles.summary: A man has been charged by UK police for stabbing two Jewish men in London. British officials have raised the national terrorism threat to its second-highest level following the incident.

articles.title: Iran war redraws sea routes with Africa as the pivot
articles.summary: The Red Sea conflict has rerouted 70 percent of 2023's freight traffic via the Cape of Good Hope in South Africa. A supply chain expert reported this significant shift in sea routes.

articles.title: Iran President Wants To Sack Foreign Minister Amid US Talks? What Report Said
articles.summary: Iranian President Pezeshkian plans to fire Foreign Minister Araghchi if he continues to act on the IRGC's instructions. This move comes amid US talks and internal power struggles. Pezeshkian has told his associates he will fire Araghchi if he continues acting on IRGC's instriction.

articles.title: Iran vows ‘long, painful’ response if US renews attacks
articles.summary: Iran has vowed a "long, painful" response if the US renews attacks. Diplomatic efforts have stalled, with a ceasefire in place since April 8. Diplomatic efforts to resolve the conflict have hit an impasse, with a ceasefire in place since April 8.

articles.title: Trump Administration Says War 'Terminated' Before 60-day Deadline
articles.summary: The Trump Administration declared that the war with Iran had "terminated" before the 60-day deadline. This update was provided in a live news report on NDTV. US Iran Ceasefire News LIVE: Trump Administration Says War 'Terminated' Before 60-day Deadline NDTV.

articles.title: What do Ukraine’s robot soldiers mean for the future of warfare?
articles.summary: Ukraine's military is testing AI-powered robots on the battlefield, allowing them to make decisions independently. The robots can detect and engage targets, marking a significant shift in the use of remote-controlled weapons.

articles.title: On May Day, Gaza’s workers find whatever source of income they can
articles.summary: Gaza's workers face dire economic conditions on May Day, with unemployment soaring due to the ongoing devastation. Many are forced to take perilous jobs to survive, as the economic collapse leaves them with limited options.

articles.title: Top Iranian officials seeking removal of Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, says report
articles.summary: Top Iranian officials are reportedly seeking the removal of Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi, according to a recent report. The move could signal a significant change in Iran's diplomatic strategy, but details remain unclear at this time.

articles.title: Why is piracy rising off Somalia again . and is the Iran war responsible?
articles.summary: Four vessels were hijacked off Somalia in the past week, raising fears of piracy. At least four vessels have been hijacked in the past week or two, raising fears of a piracy resurgence.

articles.title: Hezbollah adopts new weapon: Fibre-optic drones, used widely in war in Ukraine
articles.summary: Hezbollah is using fibre-optic drones, which are hard to jam, in the war. Fibre-optic drones have a thin cable that connects an operator directly to the drone, making it impossible to electronically jam.

articles.title: Russian attack damages port infrastructure in Ukraine's Odesa region, governor says
articles.summary: Russia damaged port infrastructure and apartments in Ukraine's Odesa region, causing fires. Two high-rise apartment buildings ‌were damaged ​in the attack, which ⁠wrecked apartments and ‌caused fires, Mr. Kiper wrote on the Telegram messaging ‌app.

articles.title: ‘Will not call it a war’: Trump signals pressure on Iran, repeats tariff claim on India and Pakistan
articles.summary: US President Donald Trump signaled increased pressure on Iran and repeated his claim that India and Pakistan would pay tariffs. He declined to refer to the situation with Iran as a war. The comments came amid heightened tensions between the US and Iran.

articles.title: What’s happening on day 63 as Trump signals possible attacks
articles.summary: Iranian President Hassan Rouhani called the US-led economic siege "intolerable" on day 63 of escalated tensions. US President Donald Trump suggested that war with Iran may resume. The situation remains volatile.

articles.title: Trump backs FIFA letting Iran play at World Cup in US
articles.summary: FIFA confirmed Iran's participation in the upcoming World Cup, with matches to be held in the US. The decision came after months of uncertainty and campaigning. Iran will compete in the tournament as scheduled.

articles.title: Zelenskyy says he's seeking details of Putin's May 9 ceasefire proposal
articles.summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy is seeking details of a proposed short-term ceasefire in eastern Ukraine, put forth by Russian President Vladimir Putin. The proposal was discussed with US President Donald Trump. Zelenskyy aims to understand the terms of the ceasefire.

articles.title: Myanmar ex-leader Aung San Suu Kyi moved to house arrest, military says
articles.summary: Myanmar's military has moved Aung San Suu Kyi to house arrest. The Nobel Peace Prize laureate has been in detention since her ouster in a military coup in 2021. The Nobel Peace Prize laureate has been in detention since she was ousted in a military coup in 2021.
